reports.title: Covista Reports First Quarter Fiscal Year 2027 Results; Raises Fiscal Year 2027 Revenue and Adjusted EPS Guidance

guidance.heading: Fiscal Year 2027 Outlook
section: Covista raised its revenue guidance for fiscal year 2027 from a range of $2,050 million to $2,090 million, or approximately 5% to 7% growth year-over-year, to a range of $2,060 million to $2,095 million, or approximately 5.5% to 7% growth year-over-year.

Covista also raised its adjusted earnings per share guidance from a range of $8.90 to $9.15, or approximately 8% to 11% growth year-over-year, to a range of $9.00 to $9.20, or approximately 9% to 11.5% growth year-over-year.
